name: electronics-drawing-skills
description: Skills for drawing electronics diagrams that people can read

plugins.name: readable-schematic
plugins.description: Lay out circuit schematics for human readers: sourced conventions and a check-by-image workflow

plugins.name: breadboard-wiring
plugins.description: Draw breadboard wiring diagrams people can follow: sourced wire-color and layout conventions and a check-by-image workflow

plugins.name: perfboard-wiring
plugins.description: Draw perfboard (universal board) wiring diagrams people can solder from: sourced layout and wiring conventions, component and solder sides, and a check-by-image workflow

plugins.name: copper-board
plugins.description: Draw copper-clad board dimension drawings (microstrip, coplanar lines, Manhattan islands) people can cut and build from: sourced dimensioning and RF-line conventions and a check-by-image workflow

plugins.name: instrument-screen
plugins.description: Write oscilloscope, spectrum analyser and VNA screen figures people can read: sourced conventions for scale, time base, RBW, sweep span, trace format, markers and cursors, and a numbers-first check-by-image workflow

plugins.name: readable-graph
plugins.description: Draw x-y graphs (frequency responses, Bode plots, resonance and characteristic curves) people can read: sourced conventions for axis labels and units, log and zero-based axes, legends, measured points vs fitted lines, and a numbers-first check-by-image workflow
